chunks: When your sister went walking and said, 'Shall I guide you to someone who can take care of him?' So We brought you back to your mother that her eye might be cooled and she not grieve. And you killed a soul, so We saved you from anguish; and We tested you with a test, so you remained for years among the people of Madyan. Then you came, [O Moses], upon a measure.
ai.seo_question: What role did Moses' sister play in his childhood according to Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to highlight the divine wisdom behind the seemingly accidental placement of Moses' sister, demonstrating how God utilized human agency to preserve the Prophet's bond with his mother. The mention of 'testing' (fitan) in Midian is viewed as a period of spiritual refinement and preparation for his prophetic mission, underscoring the theme of divine preservation amidst trials.
